fusions.name: Fraying Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a mass of fine strands through a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 6 damage to everything caught in it. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Garrote Braid
fusions.desc: Twists a braid round the target, dealing 26 damage plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Combed Snarl
fusions.desc: Strings a line of strands 6 tiles long for 6 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Locks
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a strand on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per strand (42% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 6 seconds.
